title: High scores on disk
description:
Save and load a high score table, handling every way a file can fail.

```
load: no file yet -> empty table
add Ada 1200, Bob 900 -> saved (2 entries)
load: 2 entries
file with a broken line -> loaded 1, skipped 1 (line 2)
```
hints: `std::filesystem::rename(tmp, path)` replaces the old file in one step, so a crash mid-save never leaves a half-written table (lesson 5.04).
Read with `std::getline`, then parse each line with an `std::istringstream`; a failed read means a bad line.
requirements: Save as `name score` lines; write to a temporary name and rename it into place.
Loading skips bad lines and reports them, and a missing file is not an error.
stretch: Store the file in the user's saved-games folder (`FOLDERID_SavedGames`).
